figures.shows: The log of the editor run without a window on the falling ball script: start-up lines, each step's answer and the line that says the script finished
figures.caption: After its start-up lines, the editor logs each step's answer and how the script ended.
figures.alt: Lines of log text. After the start-up lines, each command is followed by its result; the last gives the ball a height of 5.16. A line says that the script finished with five commands.
